purpose: Measure whether verified intelligence compounds by reducing future computation, error, latency, human effort, or other cost while preserving or improving verified outcome quality and provenance.
constitutional_principle: Never pay twice for proven truth; continuously distill; preserve provenance; measure waste by verified progress; reject false economies; start from the best known verified state.

promotion_rules.applied: Retrieved learning materially influences a later action.
promotion_rules.verified: Application produces a verified state change.
promotion_rules.compounded: Verified application demonstrates an attributable improvement in capability, computation, error, latency, human effort, value, or equivalent resource efficiency without violating quality, safety, authority, or provenance constraints.

hard_rules: A model assertion, memory assertion, user assertion, or unverified retrieval cannot establish a verified state change.
A cheaper result is not an optimization if it increases error, destroys provenance, creates material rework, or weakens verification.
A learning cannot be marked compounded merely because it was stored or retrieved.
Reuse claims must identify the retained knowledge and the basis for applicability.
Avoided computation is a claim and requires an explicit baseline or defensible counterfactual measurement method.
No measurement may weaken NayaPOWER authority, privacy, safety, evidence, or verification controls.
Missing required evidence blocks promotion to VERIFIED or COMPOUNDED.
The contract measures outcomes; it does not authorize actions.

governance_kernel.role: Authority, risk, decision, verification-plan, and execution-boundary control.

evidence_runtime.gap: Does not yet measure resource usage or downstream compounding.

smart_ledger_engine.role: Integrity-chained durable event record and verified value event.
smart_ledger_engine.gap: No efficiency/resource or learning-compounding event schema.

PIS_CIS.role: Capture, distill, retain, retrieve, apply, verify, and compound intelligence.
PIS_CIS.gap: Full production loop and measurable economic compounding are not yet enforced system-wide.

adaptive_learning.role: Turn verified outcomes into future behavior improvement.
adaptive_learning.gap: Needs measurable before/after evidence tied to the learning.

smart_notes.gap: Need machine-enforced promotion from note to verified reusable learning.

required_runtime_capabilities_before_cis: Canonical measurement writer at the authorized execution boundary.
Resource usage capture with provider/model/tool attribution where available.
Verified state-change linkage to evidence and receipts.
Knowledge reuse record with applicability basis.
Baseline/counterfactual mechanism for defensible avoided-cost measurement.
Learning object with provenance and retention state.
Tests proving missing evidence blocks VERIFIED and COMPOUNDED states.
non_goals: This contract does not create a new memory database.
This contract does not replace the Governance Kernel.
This contract does not replace Claim/Evidence/Verification.
This contract does not authorize model routing or execution.
This contract does not treat token minimization as an independent objective when quality or verification degrades.
